robustness.description: The solution handles Medusa order API responses for non-existent orders (404 status) by returning a 'not_found' decision rather than raising an exception
robustness.rationale: Allows the automation to gracefully handle tickets referencing invalid order IDs, providing clear feedback to customers instead of failing silently

robustness.description: The solution handles orders with missing warranty_months metadata by returning a 'not_covered' decision rather than crashing
robustness.rationale: Ensures the automation can process all orders regardless of whether warranty metadata is configured, preventing failures on products without warranty terms

robustness.description: The solution handles Mattermost channel lookup failures by falling back to 'town-square' when 'customer-loyalty' channel is not found
robustness.rationale: Ensures notifications are still delivered even if the preferred channel is unavailable, maintaining visibility for the concierge team

robustness.description: The solution parses ISO timestamp strings with timezone information correctly when comparing ticket creation times to the 24-hour cutoff
robustness.rationale: Prevents incorrect filtering of tickets due to timezone mismatches, ensuring all tickets within the actual 24-hour window are processed regardless of timezone representation

robustness.description: The solution handles missing order IDs in ticket titles by treating them as validation errors
robustness.rationale: Prevents the automation from crashing when encountering tickets without order IDs in their titles, ensuring other valid tickets are still processed

robustness.description: The solution handles malformed order IDs in ticket titles by treating them as validation errors
robustness.rationale: Prevents the automation from crashing when encountering tickets with incorrectly formatted order IDs, ensuring other valid tickets are still processed

robustness.description: The solution does not crash when encountering tickets with missing or malformed order IDs
robustness.rationale: Ensures the automation continues running and can process other tickets even when some tickets have unexpected title formats

robustness.description: The solution logs an error when Medusa authentication fails
robustness.rationale: Provides visibility into authentication failures so operators can diagnose and fix credential issues

robustness.description: The solution exits gracefully when Medusa authentication fails rather than proceeding with invalid credentials
robustness.rationale: Prevents the automation from attempting to process tickets without valid Medusa access, which would result in all validations failing and incorrect customer communications

robustness.description: The solution continues processing remaining tickets even if updating a single Zammad ticket fails
robustness.rationale: Ensures failures in updating one ticket do not prevent other valid tickets from being processed, maximizing the number of customers who receive timely warranty decisions

robustness.description: The solution continues processing remaining tickets even if validating a single order fails
robustness.rationale: Ensures failures in validating one order do not prevent other valid tickets from being processed, maximizing the number of customers who receive timely warranty decisions
